title: Who gets the yes? (Experiment 002)
format: Experiment with personified traits + rejection counter + twist; pick-one hook, short ending (learned from 001 data)

beats.text: Pick one. Each of them sends out 50 job applications. Only one gets a yes.
And it's not the most confident one.
Zero rejections. Fear never even hits send.
10 rejections. Confidence is out of fuel.
Curiosity started with the weakest battery. But after every no, it asks one question. Why?
And every answer charges it back up.
Confidence runs out. Curiosity turns every no into data.
